reference_robustness.reference_caveat: Learned from controlled same-RNA T-cell PolyA/Ribo measurements; cross-tissue universality has not been established.

profiles.Protocol Context: PolyA, SE 50 bp, HiSeq 3000 (OSD-48) → ribodepletion, PE 150 bp, HiSeq 4000 with no ERCC (OSD-168); UC Davis.
profiles.Biological Overlap Evidence: Removing enough technical-associated structure to resolve the reversal substantially disrupts the broader spaceflight-response organization; technical and biological structure are not cleanly separable.
profiles.Existing Pathway Summary: Shared same-sign genes: small-molecule catabolism, cholesterol and related hepatic metabolism.
profiles.Overall Interpretation: Opposing response; discrepancy is strongly aligned with the controlled reference, with broad influential-gene reweighting rather than simple shared-gene sign reversal.

profiles.Protocol Context: Ribodepleted, PE 150 bp, HiSeq 4000 OSD-137 → OSD-168 ERCC remeasurement; UC Davis.
profiles.Biological Overlap Evidence: Strong PC1–5 removal reduces response reproducibility, while the same removal also reorganizes the broader response geometry.
profiles.Existing Pathway Summary: Reproducible genes: hepatic small-molecule, organic-acid, lipid and broader metabolic programs.
profiles.Overall Interpretation: Response remains reproducible despite detectable alignment of its smaller replication discrepancy with the controlled reference.

profiles.Biological Overlap Evidence: The response remains highly reproducible after PC1–5 removal, although the broader reference-removal experiment still shows nonseparability.
profiles.Existing Pathway Summary: Reproducible genes: hepatic small-molecule, organic-acid, lipid and broader metabolic programs.
